result.area: After both signatures: one side simply stops (silence, refusal, cancel, removal, ending a campaign or offer, unfunded parcel, the Delayed flag) and what the signed agreement text promises
result.summary: After both signatures the code deliberately offers no cancel, remove or delete: each one refuses, and the campaign-cancel refusal says 'tell INFLX' - but from signing until the content step neither side has any button that tells INFLX anything, and the reports that do exist (Remote parcel, content step) are stored without INFLX being notified and with no admin screen that lists them. When one side stops during the shoot, reminders go every 48 hours only while a specific answer is owed and only until the posting date (a missed store visit gets none at all); then a Delayed label is stamped and money stays locked with no time limit, while content-step reminders carry on indefinitely. INFLX's item 17 tools can release a locked payment, return locked money or correct a balance with a written reason, but there is no dispute record, the 'Disputed' state is used by nothing, and after a by-hand settlement the collaboration stays Active, both sides keep being reminded and the creator gets no notification. The signed agreement says disputes 'follow the INFLX dispute process in the standard terms', standard terms v1.0 point back at 'the INFLX platform dispute resolution process', and no process, cancellation, refund or non-performance wording exists anywhere; the phone cannot open the standard terms before signing. The brand website still has older doors the no-cancel work did not close: End campaign, a signing button with no deadline check, and a Regenerate button that replaces the stored signed document with an older-format one. Evidence paths are absolute; rules line numbers refer to C:\Users\aveen\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--WORK\8589ae7a-400f-4ed9-85e4-2d125cefbee6\scratchpad\rules131.txt.

situations.rules_say: It is a dispute and INFLX handles it; there is no cancel button. A missed visit time blames nobody, and after the posting date the collaboration is only labelled Delayed.

If she agreed a time and simply did not come, nobody is reminded: the brand's row says to send a new time and her phone number is shown to him. Same, and INFLX also takes the first 25% back from her wallet if it is still there and gives it to the brand.
Same, and INFLX refunds its campaign fee to the brand.
She is given one final date; if she performs the collaboration simply carries on as Delayed.

situations.title: A party asks what the signed agreement says happens now

situations.rules_ref: Section 9 lines 421, 429 and 440; section 17A line 787 against section 22 line 844 and section 26 lines 895 and 909; section 32 line 977
situations.rules_say: INFLX's standard terms are part of every agreement and are versioned; final legal wording is deferred. The rules disagree with themselves on INFLX's role: 17A says INFLX handles the dispute and moves locked money; sections 22 and 26 say settlement is mainly outside the platform with INFLX recording and supporting.
situations.today_entry_point: The signed document (GET /agreements/:ciId/document, C:/WORK/inflx-platform/backend/src/routes/item7.routes.js:39) and the public legal pages
situations.today_effect: The document says 'Disputes follow the INFLX dispute process in the standard terms' and standard terms v1.0 say 'Any disputes shall be resolved through the INFLX platform dispute resolution process': each points at the other and no process is written. Nothing covers cancellation, refunds or non-performance, though the brand's screen describes the terms as covering 'disputes, cancellation'. On the phone the standard-terms row cannot be opened before signing (the full text appears only inside the signed PDF), yet both sides tick that they have read them. Clause 5 still promises 10% TDS, which v1.31 paused; the return clause prints 'within N days of posting' without the 'or the day she marks the shoot done, if later' the rules give. Whether a later terms version was published through admin cannot be seen from code.
situations.money_at_stake: All of it: this text is what any settlement will be measured against.
situations.gap: The promise exists, the process does not. The public pages also promise a complaint acknowledged in 24 hours and resolved in 7 days, that INFLX may hold a payout while it investigates, and that held money is 'released or returned according to what has actually happened'; the app tells a reporting side 'INFLX will contact you both'; the complaint form is only an email composer.
possible_outcomes: Publish a new standard-terms version that writes the dispute process: who may raise what and when, what INFLX may decide, timelines, what happens to each payment.
Agreements already signed stay on v1.0 and are handled under the same process as a matter of policy.
open_questions: Is INFLX the judge whose decision is final and binding, or a recorder and helper with the courts at Ongole as the real remedy? The rules say both.
Which timelines does INFLX promise for a collaboration dispute (the legal pages already say 24 hours and 7 days)?
Does the new process apply to agreements already signed under v1.0?
Will a lawyer review the wording before it is published?

not_disputes.why: Rules section 25 line 889: the label changes nothing and every step still works. It is a dispute only when one side has actually stopped.

existing_machinery.name: Return locked money to the brand
existing_machinery.what: Admin tool: everything still locked for one collaboration goes back to the brand's wallet, with a required written reason; refuses if the amount changed since the admin looked. Notifies the brand only; does not close the collaboration.

existing_machinery.name: Release a locked payment to the creator
existing_machinery.what: Admin tool: releases the next locked payment to her wallet with a reason and tells both sides; when she has posted and the brand is silent it also stands in for the brand's 'confirmed live' and dates the final 50%; releasing the final 50% completes the collaboration.

existing_machinery.name: Correct a balance
existing_machinery.what: Admin tool: add to or take from one brand's or creator's Available with a reason, never below zero. The only existing way to recover a first payment or refund a campaign fee; it cannot reach money sitting On hold in a withdrawal request.

existing_machinery.name: Record of every by-hand money move
existing_machinery.what: One row per release, return or correction with who, when, amount and reason; listed on the admin page. A dispute record can point at these rows.

existing_machinery.name: Unused 'disputed' values already in the database and the apps
existing_machinery.what: Payment status 'disputed' and 'refunded', agreement status 'disputed', a Disputed chip group with its label and colour. 'disputed' is written by nothing today; the older admin release and End campaign already respect it.

existing_machinery.name: Reports already recorded (content step and Remote parcel)
existing_machinery.what: Who reported, when, which kind and a note. A brand's content report freezes that step and holds the final payment; the lists then say 'INFLX is looking at this'. A content report tells the two parties only; a Remote report tells nobody. Nothing can lift a freeze (searched for any code clearing a report - not found) and no admin screen lists reports (searched Packages/brand-web/app/admin - not found).

existing_machinery.name: The Delayed flag with the stage it stopped at
existing_machinery.what: Stamped the day after the posting date by four arms (store visit, Remote, content, sale) and then kept up to date silently; the stage names say whose move it was. A ready-made trigger and fault hint for a dispute.

existing_machinery.name: Collaboration diary and shoot log
existing_machinery.what: Every signature, report, confirmation and INFLX release is written with actor, time and note; the shoot keeps its own action log (including a wiped 'I visited' mark). Read endpoints exist only for the pre-signing threads, so a signed collaboration's diary has no reader yet.

existing_machinery.name: Reminder lane and the 'whose move is it' functions
existing_machinery.what: Hourly job that nudges whoever must act every 48 hours; Needs You reads the same functions. Reusable for 'N days of silence, you may now raise it'.

existing_machinery.name: Admin-set day counts stamped on the collaboration
existing_machinery.what: Settings such as 'brand silence before the creator may report' are admin numbers stamped when they start, so later changes never move a promised date. The pattern for any dispute clock.

existing_machinery.name: The signed agreement as evidence
existing_machinery.what: Frozen terms snapshot, a stored PDF with a fingerprint, and each signature's typed name, time, device and network address. Caveat: the website's older signing and Regenerate doors bypass the typed name and can replace the stored PDF (see the two-versions situation).

existing_machinery.name: Standard terms versioning and admin publish page
existing_machinery.what: New wording is published as a new version; signed agreements keep the version they were signed under. This is where the dispute process text goes. A phone call to read the terms already exists but no screen uses it.

existing_machinery.name: Admin view of content files once a side has reported
existing_machinery.what: Admin can open a collaboration's content files only after a report exists.

existing_machinery.name: Withdrawals are paid by hand
existing_machinery.what: Every withdrawal is a request an admin marks Processed or Could not process with a reason; a natural place to hold a payout while a dispute is open. A suspended creator already cannot make a request.

existing_machinery.name: Admin collaboration-money list

result.summary: The Store Visit is fully built as a flow (the brand sends a plan, the two agree a time, she taps "I've been to the store", the brand confirms) but it has no door to INFLX: neither side has a report button anywhere in this step, although the Remote shoot and the content step both have one. Every awkward moment is deliberately treated as "nobody is blamed, send a new time", so the only trace is the shoot diary and the visit-time conversation. Since the founder's 1 Oct decision only the brand can confirm a visit (and only from the phone app), so a silent brand leaves her next step shut and, on Pay for Content and Hybrid, 75% of the fee locked; rules v1.31 (lines 333, 463, 476, 886) still say the visit confirms itself after three days, so rules and code disagree. Real dead ends in code today: after the posting date no plan can be sent and no new time can be saved (the set's date is locked once anyone is invited; a time already on the table can still be accepted and marked), and when the counter rounds are used up the side whose turn it is can only accept. INFLX can already move the locked money by hand from Admin > Money, but returning money does not end the collaboration (both apps carry on and the visit screens still say the money is locked), Admin has no page that lists stuck or Delayed visits, and Admin cannot confirm a visit in the brand's place. Second-read result: all 14 situations stand (9 with corrections, 5 confirmed as written) and 4 were added; the main corrections are that the "production queue" has no admin page at all, that the money tools do not tell both sides in every case, and that releasing the final 50% by hand does mark a Pay for Content collaboration Completed. All paths are under C:/WORK/inflx-platform; rules line numbers refer to rules131.txt.

result.summary: The Remote shoot is fully built (migration 191) and runs today on the stand-in courier; the real courier connector exists but both of its switches are off. It was built so that nothing ever stops: a difference never blocks her shoot, the return never holds up a payment, and Delayed and Overdue are labels only. For disputes it only records: the brand can stamp three one-time reports (difference, return problem, overdue return) that write a date and a diary line and do nothing else - nobody is notified, nothing freezes, Admin has no screen for them, the creator has no report door at all, and the return-problem report has no button on the phone. The server checks only the kind of report (and the date, for overdue); the 'needs a flagged item / a delivered return' conditions exist only as switches the phone reads. All courier money is the brand's alone: no code can charge the creator, touch the locked fee or put a value on a lost product, and INFLX has no list of the courier money brands owe it. The second reading confirmed the first reader's three money defects and found more dead ends: a courier-side cancel refunds nothing, a return that is booked but never collected (or bounces at the store) can never become overdue or be closed, and Overdue only starts once she marks the shoot done although the rule also counts from the posting date.

existing_machinery.what: Received / missing / damaged per returned item, a 'confirmed itself, nobody looked' mark, and per-item 'reported' columns that exist but are never written. The saved verdict is sent to both phones but no screen draws it.

existing_machinery.what: The brand's quiet dismissal of a difference, saved across devices. Shows the brand chose not to dispute.

existing_machinery.what: Every Remote action (address sent, booked, checked, reported, return settled, admin test events) written in order with who and when, and mirrored into the shared collaboration diary under the Shoot step.

existing_machinery.name: Courier event log
existing_machinery.what: Every courier update stored raw before anything is read from it, duplicates refused, including words INFLX does not understand ('unmapped'). The proof of collected / delivered / failed attempts.

existing_machinery.what: Both addresses as they were, box and weight, declared value, quoted and charged price, return lock, tracking number, failed-attempt count and reason, every timestamp, and the link between a first booking and its rebooking.

existing_machinery.name: Price saved per item and the parcel's declared value
existing_machinery.what: The selling price of each item is frozen when the list is saved, and their total is stored on the parcel. A ready basis for valuing a lost or unreturned product; nothing reads it today.

existing_machinery.what: One file that does every courier rupee: charge, lock, release the lock, refund a cancelled booking, settle the return, and record an amount owed that is taken from later money in. A dispute outcome that refunds or releases courier money should call these.

existing_machinery.what: A table of courier charges a brand could not pay, with reason, source parcel and the courier's words, settled automatically from later credits. No Admin view and no way to cancel one yet.

not_disputes.why: The 'book' switch turns true again once the last parcel was returned to the store (backend/src/services/remoteShoot.service.js:323-324), the phone draws the button (Packages/Mobile/src/screens/brand/BrandRemoteScreen.js:217-220), and the server only refuses when a live parcel exists (backend/src/services/remoteParcel.service.js:370-371; backend/src/services/shipping/index.js:131-138). That path skips the 'once only' check and takes a second return lock while the first is left stranded; the server would also accept a changed product list at that moment (remoteParcel.service.js:255-258). Found by reading, not run; no test covers it (backend/tests/item11-remote-return.test.js:186-191 tests only the rebook door).

not_disputes.title: Code defect: the booking endpoint trusts two internal values sent in the request
not_disputes.why: book() reads _carriedHold and rebookedFromId straight from the request body (backend/src/services/remoteParcel.service.js:386-388, 418; controller passes the body at backend/src/controllers/remoteShoot.controller.js:52-53). A request that sets _carriedHold records a return lock that was never paid, and that figure is later credited to the brand's wallet - most directly by cancelling the booking before collection (remoteParcel.service.js:573-578), also through the return settlement (backend/src/services/remoteEffects.js:223-231) or the lock release (backend/src/services/remoteReturn.service.js:253-258). Found by reading, not run; this is a money leak and should be closed before any dispute tool starts releasing locks.

not_disputes.title: Code defect: the report door stamps a 'difference' or 'return' report at any moment
not_disputes.why: The server checks only that the kind is one of three, plus the date for 'overdue' (backend/src/services/remoteReturn.service.js:117-133); the 'needs a flagged item / a delivered return' conditions exist only as switches the phone reads (backend/src/services/remoteShoot.service.js:333-335). A 'return' report stamped early would silently switch off the self-confirm for that collaboration for good (backend/src/services/remoteJobs.service.js:47). Found by reading, not run; matters as soon as item 18 treats these marks as real disputes.

result.area: Pay for Content — the content step (rules 12.2 and 22): from "shoot done" to the final 50%
result.summary: The content step is fully built and phone-only: she sends one package, the brand approves or asks for changes (2 rounds, stamped), she posts and adds links, the brand confirms live (second 25% paid, final 50% given a stamped date), and an hourly job pays the final 50% and completes the collaboration. Exactly three "tell INFLX" doors exist for Pay for Content: the brand when the change rounds are used up, the brand when what she posted is wrong, and the creator when the brand stays silent after she posted; a brand report freezes the whole step and holds the money, hers freezes nothing. A report is only a pair of columns plus a diary line: no admin is told, no admin screen lists reports or shows the rounds, files or links, nothing records a decision, and nothing can lift a freeze. Admin has three by-hand money tools from item 17 (release a locked payment, return locked money to the brand, correct a balance); paying her in full by hand does complete the collaboration, but returning money to the brand leaves it open for ever, still usable and still reminding her every two days. Several obvious failures have no door at all: she never sends, she never posts after approval, the brand never reviews, and anything after the brand has confirmed live. Some promises are already in front of users: every signed agreement says disputes follow "the INFLX dispute process" and labels the final 50% "After it stays live", the phone tells a reported creator her first payment "stays yours" and that INFLX "will look at the content" — while the usage rights the rules point to only cover where the brand may reuse content, not how long her post must stay up.

Each needs a written reason, is logged per collaboration with the admin's name, tells the person, and refuses if the picture changed since the admin looked. None needs a report to exist.

existing_machinery.what: Every agreement prints 'Disputes follow the INFLX dispute process in the standard terms', and standard terms v1.0 say disputes are resolved through the INFLX platform process and that content must be original and follow ASCI rules. not_disputes.why: The refusal is the rule (no cancellation after signing; no ending around money owed). The real dispute, if any, is whichever situation made the brand want out.

not_disputes.why: That belongs to the shoot stage (store visit / parcel), which is a separate area of the survey.

result.area: Pay for Sale and Hybrid after the shoot (shoppable posts, the social media post, going live, Hybrid's payments, selling and commission)
result.summary: After the shoot, Pay for Sale and Hybrid run on two paths: her shoppable posts (INFLX checks) and her social media post (the brand checks). Only two "tell INFLX" buttons exist: the brand's (rounds used / she hasn't posted / not what was approved / something is missing), which freezes the social step and Hybrid's locked money, and - on Hybrid only - hers (brand silent 7 days after she posted), which freezes nothing. A report is saved once per side with time, reason and note, the other side is notified and the screens say "INFLX will contact you" - but INFLX is not told, no admin screen lists reports or shows the reason, the note, the rounds or her links, nothing can lift a freeze or close a case, and no "Disputed" state is ever set; the only tools are the three by-hand money actions in Admin > Money, and they move money without closing the collaboration. Everything on the selling side (the brand ending an offer early, pulling products, stock or price, cancelling orders; her taking a post down; INFLX sending posts back or needing to pull a live one; commission queries; anything after Completed) and any stall by her before her social version is approved has no entry point at all. Three places where rules and code disagree matter for this discussion: the master rules allow INFLX two send-backs (code has no limit), say she cannot delete a live post (the offers rules and the app let her take it down), and say a sold-out post is only hidden (a brand edit at zero stock removes it for good).

result.area: The shopper's order — Shopper <-> Brand, with the creator's commission and INFLX's share riding on every item (rules 16, 17, 17A, 18; Docs/OFFER_TERMS_POSTS_RULES.md 6.8-6.16)
result.summary: The normal flow is complete while money is still pending: she can cancel until the store marks Shipped, and after Delivered she can return (or replace one item of a deal) inside INFLX's one return window; INFLX alone decides in Admin > Returns, and a refunded item undoes its three shares, stock and payment in one step. Around that flow there is no dispute machinery: no "Need help / report a problem" on an order (the rules list it, the screen leaves it empty), the store has no voice or button on a return, the creator is never told, and nothing has a deadline - not the store's shipping, not the store's collection, not INFLX's own answer. Every delivery fact (Shipped, tracking number, Delivered) is the store's own unchecked mark, and Delivered starts both the return clock and the payout clock. After Shipped nobody, not even INFLX, can cancel or refund an order that never arrives or is refused at the door; after the window closes a sale cannot be reopened, and money already in a wallet can only be touched by an unlinked balance correction that cannot go below zero. Cash-on-delivery sales are credited to the store's and creator's wallets as if INFLX had collected the cash, although shop orders do not go through INFLX's courier. Chargebacks, failed refunds, by-hand cash refunds and a payment that never became an order are tracked nowhere, and the published refund policy promises things the app does not do (photos, replacement by choice, cancel when late, refuse delivery, a pickup arranged by INFLX, a support contact).

existing_machinery.name: The shopper's request record
existing_machinery.what: One record per item asked about: kind (return / replace / refund one item), reason, her note, INFLX's note, who decided and when, items that go back together grouped under one request. The natural base for a shopper-order dispute record.

existing_machinery.name: Admin > Returns page
existing_machinery.what: INFLX's queue by state (Requested, Approved, Received, Refunded, Replaced, Rejected) with Approve, Reject (note required, shown to her) and Mark refunded. Gated by the Returns permission.

existing_machinery.name: Money waits while a request is open
existing_machinery.what: Both money jobs (hourly) skip a sale that has an open request, so a sale's three shares are already frozen for as long as INFLX is deciding. A dispute can reuse this as its freeze.

existing_machinery.name: One-step undo of an item
existing_machinery.what: Cancels the item (with the rest of its deal and a gift that no longer qualifies), puts stock back, reverses creator / INFLX / brand shares, writes the creator's history line and refunds an online payment. Used by cancel and by a completed return; works only before the sale is in the wallets.

existing_machinery.name: Splitting one unit out of an item
existing_machinery.what: Turns one unit of a quantity into its own item with its exact share of the money, so a decision can apply to a single piece. Used today only for one item of a deal.

existing_machinery.name: Per-item money split and reversal counters
existing_machinery.what: Every item stores what she paid and the three shares with the rates that made them; each sale keeps running totals of what was reversed for creator, brand and INFLX.

existing_machinery.name: Cancel and refund record on the item
existing_machinery.what: Reason, note, who cancelled (shopper / brand / admin / system / return), refund amount, refund state (pending / issued / failed / not needed / by hand) and Razorpay's refund id.

existing_machinery.name: The return window as one admin number
existing_machinery.what: One platform setting in hours or days, stamped on each sale, counted from delivery, and restartable for a sale (today only when a replacement is delivered).

existing_machinery.name: Admin order tools
existing_machinery.what: Admin > Orders lists every parcel with its money, settlement state and tracking; the server lets admin move a parcel forward and cancel an item before shipping (the cancel has no screen yet, and the page's Cancel button calls the wrong thing).

existing_machinery.name: An older admin "set any status" override, not connected
existing_machinery.what: Code that lets admin set a parcel to any status, including Cancelled, still sits in the file but no route uses it; the live route is the forward-only one. A starting point if INFLX needs to move a parcel back or close it.

existing_machinery.name: Admin > Money > Sales
existing_machinery.what: Every item sold with its three shares and where it stands (not shipped, on its way, inside the window until a date, added to wallets, cancelled, returned, cash not delivered yet).

existing_machinery.name: Admin > Money > Disputes and corrections
existing_machinery.what: By-hand tools, each with a written reason and a permanent record of who did it: correct a brand's or creator's balance up or down (never below zero), plus the two collaboration tools. The only way today to take back a share already in a wallet.

existing_machinery.name: "The brand owes INFLX" list
existing_machinery.what: An owed amount that blocks nothing and is taken automatically from the next money reaching the brand's wallet. Built for courier charges; the same idea fits lost chargebacks, late refunds and cash-order shares. Nothing like it exists for creators.

existing_machinery.name: "Payment received but not credited" repair
existing_machinery.what: An admin list and button that credits a brand's top-up payment that arrived but was never added. Brand top-ups only today; the same pattern fits a shopper payment that never became an order.

existing_machinery.name: Unconfirmed-payment safety net
existing_machinery.what: The app retries three times and offers "Check again" without asking her to pay twice; Razorpay's own message then writes the order, or refunds in full if the items sold out meanwhile.

existing_machinery.name: Wallet histories in plain words
existing_machinery.what: Brand and creator histories already label "Commission taken back", "Sales money added" and "Correction by INFLX", so dispute outcomes can show without new wording.

existing_machinery.name: Notifications at every step
existing_machinery.what: Shopper, brand and all approved admins are told when a request is made, approved, rejected, refunded or replaced; shopper and brand on a cancel and on each parcel status. The creator is told only of a new sale.

existing_machinery.name: The brand's Order Fulfillment page
existing_machinery.what: Parcels with each item, its post and creator, its three shares, the shopper's address, the open request on an item (read-only), replacements to send, and cancel-with-reason. Website only - there is no brand order screen on the phone.

existing_machinery.name: The shopper's order page
existing_machinery.what: Timeline with dates, courier and tracking, refund line, and a box showing her request's state with INFLX's note. A "Report a problem" entry would sit here; the Need help slot is reserved but empty.

existing_machinery.name: Courier connector and courier event webhook
existing_machinery.what: Shiprocket booking and delivery events, built for collaboration parcels. Carrying shop orders through it would give a real Delivered proof instead of the store's own mark.

existing_machinery.name: Shopper report -> admin decides (comments)
existing_machinery.what: An existing pattern where a shopper reports something and INFLX keeps or removes it from a queue; a model for "report a problem with this order".

existing_machinery.name: Cash-on-delivery settings
existing_machinery.what: Admin switches for cash on delivery on/off, the maximum amount per checkout and the fee, read by the app without an update.

existing_machinery.name: Suspending a store's or creator's account
existing_machinery.what: Admin can already set an approved store or creator to Suspended by hand. What a suspension does to that store's open orders and pending money was not checked.

existing_machinery.name: Published refund policy and grievance page
existing_machinery.what: The shopper-facing promises (7 days, damaged items, refund to original method, 24-hour acknowledgement, Grievance Officer) and a grievance form that composes an email. Several promises go beyond what the app does and the contacts are still placeholders.

not_disputes.title: Payment not finished within 15 minutes, or she closes the payment sheet
not_disputes.why: Nothing was ordered and nothing was charged: the hold ends, stock and gifts go back, her bag is untouched (shopperCheckout.service.js:497-507, 531-545). It becomes a dispute only if money was actually taken (see paid-no-order).

not_disputes.title: She paid, the app could not confirm at once, and the order appears a minute later
not_disputes.why: "Check again" or Razorpay's own message writes the order without a second payment (CheckoutScreen.js:186-195; webhook.controller.js:83-90). A dispute only if neither works.

not_disputes.title: She cancels before the store marks Shipped
not_disputes.why: A normal button with a required reason; refund, stock and all three shares are undone automatically (OFFER_TERMS 6.12). Only becomes a dispute if the parcel had already left or the refund fails.

not_disputes.title: The store cancels an item it cannot send
not_disputes.why: A normal button with a reason; she is told and refunded the same way. It is a dispute only when it is abused to sell around INFLX (see brand-cancels-sells-directly).

not_disputes.title: A late payment arrives after the item sold out
not_disputes.why: The whole payment is refunded automatically and no order is written (shopperCheckout.service.js:465-480). A dispute only if that refund fails.

not_disputes.title: The price, offer or stock changed between the bag and Place order
not_disputes.why: Nothing is taken; she is shown the new total before paying (shopperCheckout.service.js:304-309). Pre-commitment.

not_disputes.title: A replacement sold out before INFLX could approve it
not_disputes.why: The request closes by itself, it does not count as INFLX's one answer, and she may choose again (shopperReturns.service.js:262-270).

not_disputes.title: A return that is asked, approved, collected and refunded inside the window
not_disputes.why: This is the agreed flow working; INFLX's decision settles it and the money is undone correctly.

not_disputes.title: The return window closes while her request is still open
not_disputes.why: Her request is still answered and the sale's money keeps waiting past the window (OFFER_TERMS 6.16 line 1125; commerce-settlement.job.js:56-59). Nobody loses anything by the clock.

not_disputes.title: The return window closes with no request
not_disputes.why: The sale simply completes: commission and the store's share are added to the wallets. It becomes a dispute only if a problem is raised afterwards.

not_disputes.title: "I changed my mind" on one item of a deal
not_disputes.why: The rule is fixed: the whole deal goes back or she keeps it all (OFFER_TERMS 6.16 line 1130). A refusal here is the rule, not a disagreement about facts.

result.area: Money itself (master rules 3, 10, 17, 17A, 18, 21; wallets, locked fee, campaign fee, courier money, withdrawals, sale shares)
result.summary: INFLX holds every rupee and the wallets are records, so every money dispute is settled by INFLX changing records. Three hand tools exist in Admin > Money > "Disputes and corrections": release the next locked payment to the creator, return everything still locked to the brand, and add to or take from one wallet's Available; each needs a written reason and is recorded with who did it, works only on whole payments in order, and cannot be undone, paused, split, or reach money on hold or already withdrawn. Only two paths close cleanly today: INFLX confirming in place of a silent brand, and a Pay for Content fee released in full by hand; every other by-hand settlement leaves the collaboration open forever, and a reported Hybrid or Pay for Sale collaboration can never complete because nothing can lift a brand's report. Reports are stamped on the collaboration and its diary, but no admin is alerted and there is no list of them: the creator's "brand is silent" report is shown nowhere in Admin Money and the brand's report shows only inside the release dialog. Withdrawals, courier charges, sale shares, added money, late refunds and failed shopper refunds have no way for the person to raise a problem and no admin queue. Two hazards sit underneath: production payments are still simulated, and a delivered cash-on-delivery order adds the brand's share and the creator's commission to their wallets although the cash went to the brand's own courier (the two rules documents disagree on who holds it); the old "disputed" labels exist but nothing writes them, and one old admin release endpoint is still live beside the new tools.

situations.title: The creator took the first 25% and stopped; the brand wants its locked money back
situations.stage: After both signatures, any point before the content is confirmed live (shoot, upload, review, posting)
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content and Hybrid (the fixed fee); Store Visit and Remote
situations.rules_say: No cancellation after both sign; if either side stops it is a dispute INFLX handles, and INFLX may return locked money to the brand's wallet with a written reason. Line 908 (older) only speaks of releasing the remaining 75% to the creator, and lines 844 and 895 still call this mainly a legal matter outside the platform, so the lines pull in different directions.
situations.today_entry_point: Brand: none before the content step; cancelling is refused with 'tell INFLX' (backend/src/controllers/campaign.controller.js:1460-1463). Admin: Money > Disputes and corrections > Return locked money, POST /admin/money/corrections/return-locked (backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js:76; backend/src/services/adminMoney.service.js:453); needs the Payouts permission and offers only collaborations that still have money locked.
situations.today_effect: Every payment still locked or queued is marked returned for good and the total is added to the brand's Available in one step (owed courier charges are taken from it first); a correction row with the reason is kept and only the brand is notified. The creator is not told, the diary gets no entry, and the collaboration keeps its status and can never become Completed. Its content step is not closed: she can still upload and send and the brand can still approve; only the brand's 'Confirm it's live' is refused.

Return the locked money and also take the first 25% back from her wallet where it is still there
Give her a new date; if she delivers, the normal payments carry on
She did the shoot or part of the work: release the second 25% to her, then return the final 50% to the brand

Rule 26 line 908 says the 75% is released to the creator; rule 17A says it may go back to the brand. Which line stands?
