Two charges can be INFLX's own estimate rather than the courier's bill: the return-to-store fee falls back to the outbound price, and the return cost falls back to a fresh quote or the held amount. Admin Money has no list of what brands owe and cannot cancel an owed amount; the brand sees its owed total only on the shoot screen. A return she posts herself moves no money and records no cost.
situations.money_at_stake: The brand's Available and any amount recorded as owed; for a self-posted return, the postage she paid from her own pocket.
situations.gap: The brand cannot question a charge, Admin cannot see or waive what is owed, a refund by correction is not tied to the parcel, and INFLX has no record of what a creator spent on a self-posted return.
possible_outcomes: The charge stands (the courier's statement is the proof, where there is one)
INFLX refunds it by correction and takes it up with the courier
Wrong address was her mistake: the rule still says the brand pays
Self-posted return: she uploads the receipt and INFLX moves that amount from the brand's wallet to hers
open_questions: Will INFLX challenge courier weight charges on a brand's behalf?
Is a return-to-store fee caused by her wrong address ever hers to pay?
When INFLX charged an estimate and the courier's real bill differs, who gets or pays the difference?
Does INFLX stay out of a self-posted return's cost, as the rule says, or record and repay it?
situations.check: corrected: some charges are INFLX's estimate, not the courier's figure; a balance-correction credit does not settle owed charges; added the self-posted return (no courier pickup at her pincode), whose cost is left outside INFLX and recorded nowhere

situations.title: A withdrawal is marked Processed but the person says the money never arrived, or a different amount arrived
situations.stage: After Admin marks a withdrawal Processed
situations.applies_to: Every aim; both wallets
situations.rules_say: INFLX pays from its own bank, records the bank reference and marks it Processed; only then does the balance go down and the person is told. The full amount requested is paid.
situations.today_entry_point: Person: none (searched Packages/Mobile/src/screens/wallet, Packages/Mobile/src/components/wallet and Packages/brand-web/app/dashboard/wallet/page.js). Admin: none; a processed request cannot be reopened (backend/src/services/withdrawalRequest.service.js:191) and the dialog says it can't be undone.
situations.today_effect: The hold is already gone; the request shows Processed with the bank reference and paid date and the person was sent that reference. Only the requested amount is recorded, not what INFLX actually sent, and the reference is typed by hand with nothing attached. The only repair is a balance correction, which is not linked to the request.
situations.money_at_stake: The withdrawn amount: out of the wallet record, and in reality in INFLX's bank, in transit, bounced back, or in a wrong account.
situations.gap: No way to raise it, no 'reopen' or 'paid again' step, no place for proof beyond the typed reference.
possible_outcomes: INFLX shows the bank reference and the person traces it with their bank
The bank bounced it: the amount goes back to Available and is requested again
INFLX sent it to the wrong place or sent the wrong amount: INFLX makes it good from its own money
open_questions: What proof does INFLX give the person, and within how many days must they raise it?
Who bears the loss when the saved account details were wrong but the bank accepted the transfer?

situations.title: A withdrawal is marked Could not process, or sits past the promised 24 hours, and the person disagrees or needs the money back
situations.stage: While a withdrawal request is waiting, or just after INFLX declines to pay it
situations.applies_to: Every aim; both wallets
situations.rules_say: One request may be open at a time; the person is told it will be processed within 24 hours. If INFLX cannot pay it marks Could not process with the reason, the hold is released and the person may request again.
situations.today_entry_point: none to object, and none to take a waiting request back (no cancel route in backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js or wallet.routes.js). Admin: POST /admin/money/withdrawals/:id/could-not-process (backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js:66).
situations.today_effect: On Could not process the amount returns to Available, the person is notified with the reason and it shows in History; they can request again at once. A request older than the promised hours is only marked late in Admin's queue; the person is not told, cannot withdraw anything else, and (a brand) cannot use that money to sign an agreement until INFLX acts.
situations.money_at_stake: The requested amount, on hold with INFLX, then back in Available.
situations.gap: The 24-hour promise has no consequence, the person cannot ask why, chase, or cancel their own request from the app.
possible_outcomes: Person corrects the bank or UPI details and requests again
INFLX pays it after all
The person cancels the waiting request and the hold returns to Available
Repeated failures: INFLX contacts the person directly
open_questions: Does the 24-hour promise carry any consequence or apology step when it is missed?
May a person cancel a withdrawal request that INFLX has not yet paid?
situations.check: corrected: added that the person cannot cancel their own waiting request and only one may be open, so a stuck request locks that money (it cannot fund a signature or be withdrawn elsewhere) until INFLX acts

situations.title: Someone says their wallet balance is wrong: a movement they do not recognise, a wrong amount credited, or a correction INFLX made
situations.stage: Any time
situations.applies_to: Every aim; both wallets
situations.rules_say: Every movement is recorded once, in plain words, and shown to its owner. Admin may correct a balance with a written reason, recorded.
situations.today_entry_point: Person: none. Admin: one person's whole money picture, GET /admin/money/balances/:kind/:id; every movement searchable, GET /admin/money/movements; Correct a balance, POST /admin/money/corrections/correct-balance (backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js:68, 73, 77).
situations.today_effect: A correction adds to or takes from Available only, never below zero, up to one crore, with a reason the person reads in History as 'Correction by INFLX'. No notification is sent, the correction is not tied to the collaboration, sale or withdrawal it fixes, and one admin can do it alone.
situations.money_at_stake: Whatever amount is in question in one wallet's Available.
situations.gap: No way to question a line from the app, no notice when INFLX changes a balance, no second pair of eyes.
possible_outcomes: INFLX explains the movement and it stands
INFLX corrects the balance with a reason
A wrong correction is reversed by another correction
open_questions: Should a correction above some amount need a second admin?
Should the person be notified, and be able to object, when INFLX takes money from their wallet?

situations.title: The brand paid to add money but its Available did not go up
situations.stage: Adding money, often just before a signature or a parcel booking that needs it
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content and Hybrid signing; Remote booking
situations.rules_say: Money added is credited once for each payment and never twice; Admin can repair a payment that was received but not credited, with a written reason.
situations.today_entry_point: Brand: none. Admin: Money > Money added > Credit this payment, POST /admin/money/added/:orderId/credit (backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js:72; backend/src/services/adminMoney.service.js:241).
situations.today_effect: The wallet is credited only when the brand's own app confirms the payment; the payment provider's message to the server does not credit add-money payments, so closing the app straight after paying leaves it uncredited. The attempt shows as 'started and not finished' for 7 days and is counted on the overview. The repair credits once; with live payments it first asks Razorpay that the order was paid and belongs to that brand, in test mode nothing can be checked; the brand gets no notification from the repair.
situations.money_at_stake: The amount the brand paid: in INFLX's payment account, in nobody's wallet.
situations.gap: The brand cannot report it from the app and is not told when it is fixed; the signature or booking it was for stays blocked meanwhile; nothing credits it automatically.
possible_outcomes: Payment confirmed: credited once to the wallet
Payment never completed: brand told nothing was received
Paid but the brand no longer wants it in the wallet: withdraw by request
open_questions: While payments are still in test mode, is this repair to be used at all?
Should a confirmed payment be credited by itself when the provider tells the server, without waiting for the app or an admin?
situations.check: corrected: added the cause — the provider's webhook only logs add-money payments and never credits them (webhook.controller.js:71-76), so only the app's own confirmation or Admin's repair puts the money in the wallet

situations.title: A brand or creator disputes a sale's split: the commission percentage, INFLX's share, or which creator the sale was credited to
situations.stage: From the shopper's order until the return window closes (shares are a report), and after (shares are in the wallets)
situations.applies_to: Pay for Sale and Hybrid
situations.rules_say: Each item is split at Place order at her collaboration's percentage and INFLX's admin rate, the brand gets the rest, and the shares are frozen on the item. Sale credit follows the post the shopper bought through.
situations.today_entry_point: none. Admin can read every sale and its three shares, GET /admin/money/sales (backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js:69).
situations.today_effect: The three shares are fixed on the item and no tool changes them or moves a sale to another creator. After the window the only repair is by-hand corrections of the wallets; INFLX's own share is not adjusted by any tool.
situations.money_at_stake: In the window: the shopper's whole payment in INFLX's account, in nobody's wallet. After: the brand's share and her commission in their wallets, INFLX's share counted as earned.
situations.gap: No way to raise it and no tool to correct a split before it reaches the wallets.
possible_outcomes: The frozen split stands (it is what the agreement and the admin rate said at that moment)
INFLX corrects between the two wallets by hand
INFLX's rate was set wrongly: INFLX gives back the difference from its share
open_questions: Is a frozen split ever reopened, or is 'frozen at Place order' final?
A creator says a sale was hers but it went through another creator's post: is that ever heard?

situations.title: A refund becomes due after the sale's shares are already in the wallets, or already withdrawn
situations.stage: After the return window has closed and the three shares were added
situations.against: brand and creator (to give back their shares)
situations.applies_to: Pay for Sale and Hybrid. Ways it arises: INFLX rejected a return and later changes its mind; the shopper's bank reverses the payment; the brand marked the parcel Delivered but she says it never came (the window runs from that mark)
situations.rules_ref: 18 lines 795-801; Docs/OFFER_TERMS_POSTS_RULES.md 6.16 lines 1121 and 1127. A bank reversal is not in the rules
situations.rules_say: Shares reach the wallets only after the window closes; a return is possible only inside the window, one answer per item. Refund edge cases are left to the build stage.
situations.today_entry_point: none. A late return is refused (backend/src/services/shopperReturns.service.js:118), a rejected return cannot be reopened (deciding works only on a waiting request, line 256), marking a return refunded is refused once shares are in wallets with 'Correct it from Money before refunding' (lines 316-318), a cancel is refused the same way (backend/src/services/shopperOrders.service.js:467-469), and the payment webhook handles no bank-dispute event (backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:600-613).
situations.today_effect: Nothing is automatic. Admin would take the commission from her Available and the brand's share from its Available as two separate corrections, each stopping at zero, and there is then no button that sends the shopper her money: refunds are only issued inside the cancel and return steps.
situations.money_at_stake: The brand's share and her commission (in Available, on hold or withdrawn), INFLX's share (counted as earned), and the shopper's refund, which would leave INFLX's bank.
situations.gap: No record of money a creator owes, the brand's 'owed' record is used only for courier charges, INFLX's share cannot be reversed by a tool, no way to send a late refund, and 'Delivered' is the brand's own tap with no proof.
possible_outcomes: INFLX refunds the shopper and takes both shares back from the wallets
Shares already withdrawn: recorded as owed and taken from that person's next earnings
INFLX absorbs it as a cost of its own late decision
The brand bears the whole refund where it marked a parcel delivered that was not
open_questions: Who bears a refund after the window: INFLX, the brand, the creator, or each their own share?
May a wallet show money owed and take it from the next earnings, for creators as well as brands?
What counts as proof of delivery when the brand marks Delivered itself?
situations.check: corrected: a rejected return cannot be reopened in the tool at all (shopperReturns.service.js:256), so INFLX changing its mind is wholly by hand; webhook line range fixed to 600-613

situations.title: The shopper was told a refund is coming but it failed, or it is a cash order INFLX must pay back by hand
situations.stage: After a cancel, an approved return, or a payment that arrived after the items sold out
situations.applies_to: Pay for Sale and Hybrid orders
situations.rules_ref: Docs/OFFER_TERMS_POSTS_RULES.md 6.12 (lines 1028-1032) and 6.16 line 1126; master rules 18 line 801
situations.rules_say: An online payment is refunded automatically to where it came from; a returned cash-on-delivery order is paid back by INFLX by hand; a cancelled cash order needs no refund.
situations.today_entry_point: none.
situations.today_effect: If the payment provider refuses, the item is marked refund 'failed' with only a server log line, and her order screen says 'We couldn't start the refund. INFLX will sort it out and tell you'; a returned cash order is marked 'manual' and her screen says INFLX will send it to her directly. Nothing backs either promise: there is no retry button or job and nowhere to record that INFLX paid (searched backend/src controllers, routes and jobs for refund_status: none). A payment that lands after the hold ended and the stock is gone is marked refunded even when the refund call failed.
situations.money_at_stake: The item's price (or the whole payment in the sold-out case), still in INFLX's account; the three shares were already undone.
situations.gap: No queue of failed or by-hand refunds, no retry, no reference recorded, no way to collect her bank or UPI details for a cash refund, nothing the shopper can press.
possible_outcomes: Admin retries the refund to the original payment
INFLX pays her directly and records the reference
She is shown the refund reference and traces it with her bank
open_questions: How does INFLX pay back a cash order: where does it get her UPI or bank details, and within how many days?
situations.check: corrected: the shopper does see the refund state and is promised that INFLX will sort it out, with nothing behind the promise; added the third failure path (paid after sold out: marked refunded even if the refund call failed)

situations.title: Cash on delivery: the shopper's cash goes to the brand's own courier, yet INFLX adds the brand's share and the creator's commission to their wallets
situations.stage: A cash order the brand marks Delivered, then the close of its return window
situations.raised_by: INFLX (it is the one out of pocket); later the brand or creator if INFLX tries to take it back
situations.applies_to: Pay for Sale and Hybrid orders paid by cash on delivery (on by default, up to Rs 5,000)
situations.rules_ref: Master 17A line 777 against Docs/OFFER_TERMS_POSTS_RULES.md 6.13 lines 1075 and 1081-1084; the two disagree
situations.rules_say: The master rules say INFLX collects the cash through the delivery partner, the brand holds none of it and owes nothing, and until that partner is connected the Delivered status stands in. The offers-and-orders rules say the brand's courier collects the cash, the money is with the brand, and the brand owes INFLX the creator's share plus INFLX's share.
situations.today_entry_point: none. The brand ships with its own courier and marks Delivered itself, PATCH /brands/me/orders/:id/status (backend/src/routes/brand.routes.js:77; backend/src/services/shopperOrders.service.js:605-629).
situations.today_effect: Once the brand marks a cash order Delivered it is treated exactly like a paid online order: after the window the brand's share is added to the brand's wallet and the commission to the creator's, both withdrawable from INFLX's bank, and INFLX's share counts as earned. No delivery partner is connected for shop orders, nothing records that INFLX received the cash, and the older 'brand owes INFLX' record for cash orders is no longer created.
situations.money_at_stake: For every cash sale: the full price in cash with the brand or its courier, plus the brand's share and the creator's commission credited again from INFLX's own money.
situations.gap: No proof INFLX holds the cash, no amount owed by the brand for a cash order, and the two rules documents contradict each other on who collects.
possible_outcomes: Switch cash on delivery off until a delivery partner collects the cash for INFLX
Go back to the earlier rule: the brand keeps the cash and owes INFLX the creator's share and INFLX's share, taken from its next money in
Keep it as built and accept the exposure only while payments are still in test mode
open_questions: Who physically receives a shopper's cash today, and which of the two rules stands?
Should cash orders be credited to wallets at all before INFLX has the cash in its own account?

situations.title: The brand goes quiet before she has posted (never sends the products, never reviews or approves her content): her remaining 75% stays locked and she has no button
situations.stage: After both signatures, from the shoot plan up to the brand's approval of her content
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content and Hybrid; Store Visit and Remote
situations.rules_ref: 17A line 787 ('or the Brand after the Agreement'); 12.2 lines 621-622 (no time limit, reminders only); 26 line 904
situations.rules_say: If the brand stops after the agreement it is a dispute INFLX handles. There is no time limit on a review; whoever must move sees it in Needs You with reminders. The dispute table has no row of its own for a brand that does not perform.
situations.today_entry_point: none. Her only report is 'the brand is silent', and it opens only after she has marked the content Posted (backend/src/services/contentFlow.service.js:786-791).
situations.today_effect: Reminders to the brand and, past the Posting Date, a Delayed label; nothing else. The 75% stays locked for both sides with no date. Admin sees it only as locked money and could release the next payment 'as the payment only', then the final 50% (which completes a Pay for Content collaboration), or return it all to the brand.
situations.money_at_stake: 75% of the fee locked with INFLX: she cannot earn it and the brand cannot use it; the campaign fee is already INFLX's.
situations.gap: No way for the creator to raise it, no clock on the brand, no signal to INFLX, and no rule for what she is owed when the brand, not she, is the one who stopped.
possible_outcomes: She did her part (shoot done, content uploaded): INFLX releases the remaining payments to her
Nothing was produced: INFLX returns the locked money to the brand and she keeps the first 25%
INFLX gives the brand a deadline; if it passes, INFLX decides in her favour
open_questions: How many days may a brand sit on a review, or on sending the products, before she can tell INFLX?
When the brand is the one who stopped, is she owed the full fee, or only for the work done?

situations.title: One side says INFLX's own money decision was wrong (a payment released, locked money returned, a balance corrected) and wants it reversed
situations.stage: After INFLX has used one of the three hand tools
situations.applies_to: Every aim; mostly Pay for Content and Hybrid
situations.rules_ref: 17A lines 787 and 789; 26 lines 907 and 909. An appeal or a reversal is not in the rules
situations.rules_say: INFLX may release or return locked money and correct a balance, each with a written reason, recorded. Nothing says whether the decision is final or can be challenged.
situations.today_entry_point: none for either side. For Admin there is no undo: both dialogs say it cannot be undone and that returned payments can never be released afterwards (Packages/brand-web/app/admin/money/corrections/page.js:138 and 148; backend/src/services/adminMoney.service.js:393-394 and 466).
situations.today_effect: The money has already moved into a wallet and can be withdrawn or re-used at once. One admin decides alone, the other side is not heard first, and on a return the creator is not even told. The only repair is a pair of unlinked balance corrections, each stopping at zero.
situations.money_at_stake: The payment that moved: in her Available or already withdrawn, or back in the brand's Available and possibly locked again elsewhere.
situations.gap: No second approval, no notice-and-reply step before money moves, no appeal window, no reversal, and no link between the decision and the report that caused it.
possible_outcomes: INFLX's decision is final and both sides are told so in the terms
A short appeal window during which the moved money cannot be withdrawn
A reversal step that undoes a release or a return as one recorded action
open_questions: Is INFLX's decision final, or can the losing side appeal, and to whom?
Should money moved by a decision be held for some days before it can be withdrawn?
Should decisions above an amount need a second admin?

situations.title: The shopper paid, the brand marked it Shipped, and it never arrives or is never marked Delivered: her money sits with INFLX and nobody can release it
situations.stage: After a shop order is marked Shipped
situations.raised_by: shopper (and the creator waiting for her commission)
situations.applies_to: Pay for Sale and Hybrid orders paid online
situations.rules_ref: Docs/OFFER_TERMS_POSTS_RULES.md 6.12 line 1036 and 6.16 lines 1115-1116 and 1121; master 17A lines 772-775. Non-delivery is not in the rules
situations.rules_say: After Shipped cancelling is closed and she returns it once delivered; a return needs a delivered item; until it is delivered nothing is added to anyone.
situations.today_entry_point: none. Cancel is refused once shipped for the shopper, the brand and Admin alike (backend/src/services/shopperOrders.service.js:38 and 440; backend/src/controllers/shopperOrders.controller.js:82); a return needs delivery (backend/src/services/shopperReturns.service.js:117); only the brand or Admin can mark Delivered and there is no timer.
situations.today_effect: The payment stays in INFLX's account in nobody's wallet with no end date; the brand's share and the creator's commission stay 'still to come'; no one is alerted. Admin's only moves are to mark it Delivered (which starts the return window) or to leave it; there is no refund for a shipped parcel.
situations.money_at_stake: The shopper's whole payment, held by INFLX; the brand's share and the creator's commission, waiting.
situations.gap: No 'it never came' button, no deadline after Shipped, no proof of delivery, no admin refund for a shipped order.
possible_outcomes: INFLX refunds the shopper and all three shares are undone
The brand shows proof of delivery: marked Delivered and the window starts
After a set number of days undelivered the order is flagged to INFLX automatically
open_questions: How many days after Shipped may a shopper say it never arrived?
What counts as proof of delivery, and who bears a parcel the courier lost?

situations.title: A brand's add-money payment is reversed by its bank after that money was already locked, paid to a creator or withdrawn
situations.stage: Days or weeks after a brand added money (possible only once payments are live)
situations.raised_by: the brand's bank or card company, through the payment provider
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content and Hybrid funding; Remote courier money
situations.rules_ref: not in the rules (17A line 763 only says money added is credited once)
situations.rules_say: Nothing.
situations.today_entry_point: none. The payment webhook handles no reversal or dispute event (backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:600-613).
situations.today_effect: Nothing happens: the wallet and the locked money still show the amount and every payment to the creator carries on. By hand, Admin could take from the brand's Available (never below zero) and could only return locked money to that same brand's wallet before taking it; what a creator was already paid is untouched.
situations.money_at_stake: The added amount: gone from INFLX's bank, still owed in INFLX's records to the brand, the creator, or already paid out.
situations.gap: No alert, no way to freeze a brand's wallet or its locked collaborations, and no 'brand owes INFLX' record other than courier charges.
possible_outcomes: INFLX contests the reversal with the signed agreement as proof
The brand's wallet and locked money are frozen and taken back; the creator keeps what was already released
What cannot be recovered is recorded as owed by the brand, or borne by INFLX
open_questions: If a brand's payment is reversed after the creator was paid from it, who bears the loss?
Should newly added money wait some days before it can be withdrawn?

situations.title: INFLX suspends a brand or creator who has money in the wallet or a signed collaboration in progress
situations.stage: Any time after a signature or a sale
situations.raised_by: INFLX (by suspending); then the suspended person, or the other side of their collaboration
situations.applies_to: Every aim; both wallets
situations.rules_ref: not in the rules (searched the rules text for 'suspend': none)
situations.rules_say: Nothing.
situations.today_entry_point: Admin suspends an account (backend/src/controllers/admin.controller.js:132-196 for a brand, 222-280 for a creator). Nothing for the person or the other side.
situations.today_effect: Suspension moves no money and records nothing about it. A suspended creator cannot ask to withdraw, while a suspended brand still can; either one loses the buttons of the content step, so a signed collaboration stalls with the fee locked and the other side has nothing to press. Automatic payments (the final 50%, commission, sales money) still arrive in a suspended account's wallet.
situations.money_at_stake: The suspended person's Available and on-hold money, the fee locked in their collaborations, and shares still inside return windows.
situations.gap: No rule for a suspended account's money, different treatment of brands and creators, and no way to close out the collaborations a suspension freezes.
possible_outcomes: Suspension freezes withdrawals for brand and creator alike until INFLX decides
INFLX settles each open collaboration (release or return) as part of suspending
On a permanent closure the remaining balance is paid out after a waiting period
open_questions: When INFLX suspends someone, what happens to their wallet, their locked money and their open collaborations?
May a suspended brand withdraw while a suspended creator cannot?

existing_machinery.name: Tool 1: Release a locked payment (to the creator's wallet)
existing_machinery.what: Needs the Payouts permission, the collaboration, the payment the admin was shown, and a reason of 5-500 characters. Releases only the NEXT locked or queued payment, whole (a queued final 50% can be released before its date); refuses if anything changed since the screen opened. Leaves: (a) second 25% when she has posted and the brand has neither confirmed nor reported: INFLX stands in for the brand, content marked live, final 50% gets its date and the collaboration completes normally; (b) second 25% in any other state: that payment only, final 50% stays locked, the brand's own Confirm is refused afterwards, collaboration stays open; (c) final 50%: paid; a Pay for Content collaboration completes, a Hybrid one only if it was confirmed live, is not under a brand report and her minimum shop posts are approved. Both sides are notified and the diary records it.

existing_machinery.name: Tool 2: Return locked money (to the brand's wallet)
existing_machinery.what: Needs the collaboration, the amount shown, and a reason. Returns EVERYTHING still locked or queued in one step (never part), marks those payments returned for good, credits the brand's Available and settles any owed courier charge from it. Does not touch the first 25% already paid or the campaign fee. Leaves the collaboration with its old status, no ending and its content step still usable; only the brand is notified; no diary entry.

existing_machinery.name: Tool 3: Correct a balance (add to or take from one wallet)
existing_machinery.what: Brand or creator, add or take, up to one crore, reason required. Works on Available only and never takes it below zero. The person reads it in History as 'Correction by INFLX' with the reason; no notification; not linked to any collaboration, sale or withdrawal; an added amount does not settle courier charges the brand owes.

existing_machinery.name: What the three tools cannot do today
existing_machinery.what: Split a payment or pay part of one; release out of order; pause or hold a payment without returning it; undo a release or a return; reach money on hold or already withdrawn; let a wallet go below zero or record a debt for a creator; move money from one wallet to the other in one recorded step; refund the campaign fee as a fee (INFLX's earnings figure would not change); charge a penalty or pay a brand for a lost product except as two unlinked corrections; reopen a processed withdrawal; change a sale's three shares; send a refund to a shopper outside the cancel and return steps; cancel a courier amount a brand owes or release a return-shipping hold; lift a brand report's freeze; give the collaboration an ending such as Disputed or Closed; require a second admin.

existing_machinery.name: Record of everything done by hand
existing_machinery.what: One table and one admin list of every release, return, balance correction and repaired top-up: amount, direction, reason, who and when. It already has columns for the brand, the creator and the collaboration, so a dispute record could point at these rows. A second record of by-hand releases (in use, not dead) is what makes both wallets' History say 'released by INFLX'.

existing_machinery.name: Repair for money added but not credited
existing_machinery.what: Admin credits a paid add-money order once; with live payments it checks with Razorpay that the order was paid by that brand; in test mode nothing is checked.

existing_machinery.name: Withdrawal queue with Processed and Could not process
existing_machinery.what: One queue for brands and creators; Processed needs a typed bank reference, Could not process needs a reason and returns the hold; late requests are marked; the person is notified both ways. A dispute about a withdrawal should hang off this request record.

existing_machinery.name: Admin money reading screens
existing_machinery.what: Overview of what INFLX holds and for whom; balances; one person's whole money picture (history, collaborations, sales, withdrawals); every sale with its three shares; collaboration money with a 'Waiting on a brand' tab (days since she posted; no report mark on the list); every movement, searchable. These are the evidence screens a dispute officer needs.

existing_machinery.name: Reports already stamped on a collaboration
existing_machinery.what: Content step: the brand's report with kind and note (freezes the step and holds the final payment) and the creator's 'brand is silent' report (freezes nothing). Remote parcel: three brand reports (difference, return problem, overdue). All are written to the diary or shoot log. None alerts an admin, none is listed for Admin (Admin Money reads only whether a brand report exists), and none can be closed.

existing_machinery.name: Collaboration diary
existing_machinery.what: One shared history per collaboration that both sides read identically, with an 'admin' actor already allowed; the release tool writes to it (the return tool does not). A dispute's opening, evidence and outcome can be diary entries.

existing_machinery.name: Server link for Admin to open a creator's content files once reported
existing_machinery.what: A time-limited link to her uploaded files, allowed for an admin with the Production permission only after either side has reported. It exists on the server only: no admin page calls it today (searched Packages/brand-web for 'admin/collabs' and 'content/files': none).

existing_machinery.name: 'Owed' record for brands
existing_machinery.what: A courier charge the wallet cannot cover is recorded as owed, blocks nothing, and is taken oldest-first from the brand's next top-up, sales money or returned locked money. A ready pattern for 'this person owes INFLX', but used only for courier charges, only for brands, and with no admin screen.

existing_machinery.name: Shopper Returns queue (INFLX decides)
existing_machinery.what: Admin approves or rejects each return, replacement or one-item refund, then marks it refunded; the sale's three shares wait while a request is open; shopper, brand and every admin are notified at each step. The nearest thing to a working dispute queue today, and the only place that already alerts all admins.

existing_machinery.name: Refund to a shopper's original payment, and a refund state on each item
existing_machinery.what: One function sends part or all of a shopper's payment back to where it came from, and every cancelled or returned item carries a refund state (on its way, issued, failed, by hand, not needed) and a refund reference. Used only inside cancel, return and the sold-out case; a failed-refund queue or a late refund could be built on it.

existing_machinery.name: Money notifications
existing_machinery.what: Messages already exist for a payment released by INFLX, locked money returned by INFLX (brand only), a withdrawal processed and a withdrawal that could not be processed.

existing_machinery.name: Admin settings that set dispute clocks
existing_machinery.what: Money > Settings shows five numbers: minimum withdrawal, hours to process a withdrawal, return window, campaign fee percentage, final-payment wait. Two more live on the platform settings page: change rounds before a rejection becomes a dispute, and days of brand silence before she may tell INFLX; the Remote return window and its self-confirm days are there too. Each is stamped on the collaboration, sale or request when it starts.

existing_machinery.name: Test-mode warning
existing_machinery.what: Admin Money shows a red TEST MODE banner on the Overview, on Withdrawals and inside Mark processed while payments are simulated, so nobody pays real money against money that never came in. Any dispute payout tool should carry the same warning.

existing_machinery.name: Old unused pieces: 'disputed' labels
existing_machinery.what: The escrow status list and the contract status list both contain 'disputed', and the collaboration chip families include 'Disputed'. Nothing in the code ever writes any of them (searched backend/src for 'disputed': three read-only mentions); the chip function never returns that family.

existing_machinery.name: Old piece still live: the earlier admin release endpoint
existing_machinery.what: POST /admin/escrow/:id/release still works under the older Escrow permission. It releases any one payment by its id with a required reason, but skips the order check, does not keep the collaboration in step (no live confirmation, no completion), writes no correction row and tells nobody. Its web page already redirects to Money. Item 18 should retire it or fold it into Tool 1. There is no dispute handler in admin.controller.js or campaign.controller.js; the old cancel-and-refund path was removed and now refuses once anything is signed.

existing_machinery.name: Agreement wording that already points to a dispute process
existing_machinery.what: Every agreement says disputes follow the INFLX dispute process in the standard terms, so whatever is decided must be written into those terms.

not_disputes.title: The brand's balance is short at signing or at parcel booking
not_disputes.why: It simply cannot sign or book until it adds money; nothing is committed yet and nobody is harmed (rules 9 line 437, 11.2 line 508).

not_disputes.title: A parcel booking cancelled before the courier collects
not_disputes.why: A normal button: the courier price and the return hold both go back to the brand automatically (backend/src/services/remoteMoney.service.js:198-209).

not_disputes.title: A courier charge recorded as 'owed'
not_disputes.why: It is a record, not a penalty: it blocks nothing and is taken from the next money in. It becomes a dispute only if the brand says the charge itself is wrong.

not_disputes.title: The final 50% waiting for its date
not_disputes.why: A stamped wait, not a hold: it is paid by itself on the date (backend/src/jobs/tranche-3-release.job.js:33-45).

not_disputes.title: A shopper cancels before the parcel ships, or returns an item inside the window
not_disputes.why: Handled by the normal Cancel button and the Returns queue; the shares were never in a wallet, so no money has to be taken back. A cancelled cash order needs no refund at all.

not_disputes.title: A withdrawal refused for being under the minimum, over Available, or a second request while one is open
not_disputes.why: Ordinary rules of the Withdraw screen, shown before anything is requested (backend/src/services/withdrawalRequest.service.js:108-110).

not_disputes.title: A campaign cancelled before any collaboration is signed by both
not_disputes.why: Nothing is locked, so cancelling moves no money (backend/src/controllers/campaign.controller.js:1465-1467).

not_disputes.title: The Delayed flag after the Posting Date
not_disputes.why: A label for both sides and Admin; no money moves and every step stays open (rule 25 line 889).

not_disputes.title: An older pay-at-store or prebook sale that never reaches a wallet
not_disputes.why: Only sales that came through the shopper checkout become wallet money; the older test rows are deliberately left as they are (backend/src/services/settlement.service.js:84-87), so a 'pending' figure from them is not missing money.

not_disputes.title: Money 'added' while payments are in test mode
not_disputes.why: Not a disagreement between parties but a hazard for INFLX: the wallet shows money INFLX never received, so no real withdrawal or dispute payout should be made against it (backend/src/services/withdrawalRequest.service.js:303-308).

result.area: admin-and-visibility: what INFLX (the admin) can see and do today when something is reported
result.summary: INFLX's admin site has one report queue that works end to end - shopper returns (approve, reject with a reason the shopper reads, mark refunded) - plus a small keep-or-remove queue for reported comments; only returns notify the admins, and the admin site has no notification bell or menu count to show it. Every collaboration report (the brand's content report, her 'brand is silent' report, the three Remote parcel reports) is only stamped on the record and written to the diary: no admin is told, no page lists them, and the written note is never read back to anyone, not even the person who wrote it. What admin does have is money tools (Money > Disputes and corrections: release a locked payment, return locked money, correct a balance, each with a written reason), read-only money lists, phone numbers on the brand and creator pages, and account suspension; it cannot open a collaboration, read its diary, view content files from any page, write a decision either side can read, lift a freeze or close a collaboration. After reporting, each side sees one line ('Reported to INFLX', 'INFLX is looking at this', 'INFLX will contact you both') and nothing ever follows. Delayed is only a label set the day after the posting date (both told once, nothing stops, and no admin page shows it although the rules say it is for Admin too), while a brand's content report truly freezes the step - yet no 'Disputed' state is ever written, the card chip keeps reading Waiting, and nothing in the code can clear a report. Needs You is built only for brands and creators: INFLX has no work list and no clock on its own answers, and its Orders page cannot cancel or refund an order that has shipped.

situations.title: A brand reports the creator's content to INFLX - and INFLX never finds out
situations.stage: Content step: in review after all change rounds are used, or after she marked it posted. Pay for Sale/Hybrid also when her social version is approved and the posting date has passed.
situations.applies_to: All three aims, both modes. Pay for Content reasons: rounds used; posted wrong. Pay for Sale/Hybrid add: something missing; not posted. Phone app only - the brand website has no report call.
situations.rules_say: Once the change rounds are used the brand may only approve or report. A brand's report is a dispute: it freezes the step, no money moves and her fee stays locked until INFLX settles it. Admin sees the content files only when a dispute is raised.
situations.today_entry_point: 'Report to INFLX' / 'Something's wrong - tell INFLX' on the brand's content screen in the phone app -> POST /campaigns/:id/sets/:sid/invitations/:ciId/content/report (C:/WORK/inflx-platform/backend/src/routes/item12.routes.js:43; backend/src/services/contentFlow.service.js:760-814)
situations.today_effect: The reason, an optional note and the time are saved on the content record and one diary line is written. The step freezes: no upload, approval or confirmation; reminders stop; the final-payment job, Pay for Sale self-confirmation and completion all skip it. Both sides get one message and the card reads 'Reported to INFLX' / 'INFLX is looking at this' under a 'Waiting' chip. No admin is notified and no page lists it; the only trace on the admin site is one sentence ('The brand reported this collaboration') inside the Release-a-payment dialog after that collaboration is picked. The note is read back to nobody.
situations.money_at_stake: Pay for Content / Hybrid: the first 25% is already in her wallet and can be withdrawn; the second 25% and final 50% stay locked with INFLX. Pay for Sale: no fixed money; her shop posts keep selling and commission keeps accruing.
situations.gap: No admin queue or alert; the reason and note cannot be read; admin cannot open the collaboration or its files (a 5-minute file link for admin exists, but under a different permission from the money tools, no page calls it and nothing gives admin the list of files); no decision record; nothing ever clears a report, so the step stays frozen for good. A Pay for Sale report is invisible even in Money, which lists only collaborations with locked money. An older release endpoint would still pay a frozen collaboration's payment with none of these checks.
possible_outcomes: INFLX sides with the creator: release the second 25% and final 50% to her wallet; collaboration ends Completed
INFLX sides with the brand: return the locked 75% to the brand's wallet, she keeps the first 25%; collaboration ends Closed after dispute
Split: release the second 25% to her, return the final 50% to the brand; Closed after dispute
Lift the freeze and let the flow continue (one extra change round, or she re-posts correctly) with no money moved by hand
Brand withdraws its report; freeze lifted, flow continues
Pay for Sale: no money to move - INFLX records a decision; collaboration marked Completed or Closed, her shop posts stay or are taken down

situations.applies_to: All withdrawals
situations.rules_say: INFLX pays from its own bank, records the bank reference and marks it Processed; only then does the balance go down. If it cannot pay it marks Could not process and the hold is released. Nothing is said about a payment marked paid that did not arrive.
situations.today_entry_point: none for the person. Admin side: Money > Withdrawals -> POST /admin/money/withdrawals/:id/processed (C:/WORK/inflx-platform/backend/src/routes/item17.routes.js:65)
situations.today_effect: Marking Processed takes the amount out of the wallet for good, writes a history line with the bank reference and tells the person. A processed request cannot be reopened or reversed. If the person complains, the only repair is Correct a balance (add it back, with a reason) and a new request.

situations.gap: No 'I did not receive it' button, no reopening, and nothing linking the complaint, the bank reference and the correction.

existing_machinery.name: Content report fields and the two report buttons
existing_machinery.what: On each collaboration's content record: when the brand reported, who, which reason (rounds used / posted wrong / not posted / missing) and a 500-character note; the same for her 'brand is silent' report. One endpoint per side with the timing rules already enforced. The notes are saved but no screen or endpoint reads them back.

existing_machinery.name: The freeze
existing_machinery.what: One guard that stops every write on a collaboration the brand has reported; reminders, the final-payment job, Pay for Sale self-confirmation and completion already respect it. Missing only its opposite: a way to lift it.

existing_machinery.name: Remote parcel report fields and endpoint
existing_machinery.what: Three stamps on the shoot (difference reported, return problem reported, overdue reported) plus 'brand said carry on', and one endpoint taking the three kinds (it would store a note; the phone sends none, and only two of the three kinds have a button). Per-item 'reported' columns exist but are never written.

existing_machinery.name: Admin link to view content files during a dispute
existing_machinery.what: A 300-second view link for one file, given to admin only once either side has reported - exactly the rule in 12.2. No page uses it, nothing gives admin the list of files, and it needs the old 'production' permission (held by reviewers, not by the finance role that holds the money tools).

existing_machinery.name: Money tools for settling (Disputes and corrections)
existing_machinery.what: Release the next locked payment to the creator (tells both sides, writes a diary line), return everything still locked to the brand (tells only the brand, no diary line), add to or take from one wallet (no notification; the reason shows in the person's history). Each needs a written reason, checks nothing changed since the admin looked, and records who did it. Money only ever moves into or out of a wallet.

existing_machinery.name: Older by-hand release door (still live)
existing_machinery.what: An earlier endpoint that releases any one locked payment with a required reason. It skips everything item 17 added: it ignores a brand's report, tells nobody, writes no diary line, leaves no row in the Disputes and corrections list and does not complete the collaboration. Its page was retired; the endpoint and the website's call remain, under the separate 'escrow' permission. Should be retired or folded into the one tool.

existing_machinery.name: Collaboration money list
existing_machinery.what: Admin's read-only list of every collaboration with locked money: paid, locked, next payment, and a 'Waiting on a brand' tab showing how many days since she posted. Each row already carries a 'reported' flag (brand reports only) that is shown nowhere except as one sentence in the release dialog. Pay for Sale collaborations never appear.

existing_machinery.name: The collaboration diary
existing_machinery.what: One shared record of what happened at each of the six steps (who, what changed, note), already accepting 'admin' and 'system' as the actor; reports, shoot and parcel actions and INFLX's hand release are written to it. For a signed collaboration nothing reads it back - the only reading endpoints are for the pre-campaign conversation and the pitch, and only for the two parties.

existing_machinery.name: The shoot log
existing_machinery.what: Every shoot and parcel action with time and actor, mirrored into the diary; includes 'reported_difference', 'attended_cleared', 'return_auto_confirmed', 'delayed'. Readable by the two parties, not by admin.

existing_machinery.name: Delayed flag
existing_machinery.what: Two fields on the collaboration (when, and the stage it stopped at) set hourly the day after the posting date; both sides told once; the stage follows the collaboration afterwards. A label only - no state, money or step changes. A ready-made trigger for 'offer to report' or for an admin watch list; today no admin page shows it.

existing_machinery.name: Needs You and 'whose move' rules
existing_machinery.what: One server-side rule per step for whose move it is, used by the cards, the badges and the 48-hour reminders. A reported collaboration is already 'nobody's move' with the lines 'Reported to INFLX' / 'INFLX is looking at this'. Built for brand and creator only - INFLX is never the one who owes a move, even while a post waits in its queue.

existing_machinery.name: Notifications and the 'tell every admin' pattern
existing_machinery.what: One send function writes the in-app notification and pushes to the phone. Shopper returns already notify every approved admin user - the only thing in the system that does; the admin website has no bell to show them, only menu counts for approvals and withdrawals.

existing_machinery.name: Returns queue (the working model)
existing_machinery.what: A list by status, a decision with a required reason that the shopper sees, a completion step that moves the money, and status on the reporter's screen at every stage. The shape a collaboration dispute queue can copy.

existing_machinery.name: Comment reports queue
existing_machinery.what: Reported comments wait oldest first; admin removes or keeps; the decision and who made it are stored on the report rows. Nobody is notified at either end.

existing_machinery.name: Withdrawals queue with a clock
existing_machinery.what: The one admin queue that has a time limit on INFLX itself: each request is stamped with the promised hours, turns amber when late, and the menu shows how many are waiting. The pattern a dispute queue's own deadline can copy.

existing_machinery.name: Admin numbers stamped when they start to matter
existing_machinery.what: Settings with a range, a plain description and an audit trail; each is copied onto the record when it applies so a later change never moves a running case. Already holds content change rounds, brand-silence days, final-payment wait, return auto-confirm days. Dispute time limits belong here.

existing_machinery.name: Orders oversight
existing_machinery.what: Admin can move a shopper order's status forward only. Cancelling is weaker than it looks: the page's 'Cancel order' button sends a status the server refuses, and the server's real admin cancel works only before shipping and has no page. Nothing lets admin refund a shipped order or undo a wrong Delivered.

existing_machinery.name: Account suspension and contact details
existing_machinery.what: Admin can suspend or reinstate a brand or creator; a suspended account's actions are refused at the door (a suspended creator cannot ask to withdraw; a suspended brand still can). Background jobs ignore suspension and the other side is not told. Brand, creator and shopper phone numbers are shown on admin pages for contact outside the app - there is no in-app message from INFLX to a party about a collaboration.

existing_machinery.name: Admin permissions list
existing_machinery.what: Each admin page is tied to a named permission; a 'disputes' permission can be added the same way. Today the pieces a dispute needs are split across four permissions: money tools ('payouts'), the content file link ('production'), the older release door ('escrow') and returns ('returns').

existing_machinery.name: Unused 'disputed' words already in the data
existing_machinery.what: A 'disputed' payment status, a 'disputed' agreement status, and a 'Disputed' chip family and label - defined, checked in two places, never set. A reported collaboration's chip reads 'Waiting'.

existing_machinery.name: Old admin attention list for shoots
existing_machinery.what: An endpoint that lists stuck shoots with reasons, including the Delayed date and stage and whether the collaboration is signed and funded - but only for shoots already stale for other reasons. Its page was retired; the endpoint and the website's API call remain.

existing_machinery.name: Old admin 'cancel the shoot' endpoint
existing_machinery.what: Any admin can set a shoot to 'cancelled' with a reason; it is logged in the shoot log and the diary. No page calls it and nothing else about the collaboration or its money changes. The only existing admin action that touches a collaboration's own state.

existing_machinery.name: Post Queue (INFLX's own review)
existing_machinery.what: Admin approves or sends back a shop post that is awaiting review, with a reason the creator sees and a diary line. It cannot touch a post once approved, sends no alert to admins when a post arrives and has no count on the menu.

not_disputes.title: Delayed (posting date passed)
not_disputes.why: A label only: set the day after the posting date, both sides told once, the stage shown follows the collaboration. Nothing freezes, no money moves, every step stays open (rules 25 line 889). It becomes a dispute only if someone reports - and today most Delayed collaborations have no report button to press.

not_disputes.title: A reported comment on a post
not_disputes.why: Moderation of a shopper's comment, not a broken promise between committed parties. Admin removes or keeps it on the Comment reports page; the reporter gets no reply and nobody is notified.

not_disputes.title: INFLX sends a shoppable post back
not_disputes.why: The normal quality review with its own reason and resubmit; the creator fixes and sends again, as many times as needed.

not_disputes.title: A shop post INFLX approves after the posting date
not_disputes.why: The rules say it still counts and there is no penalty; the brand just sees it marked late (12.1 line 564).

not_disputes.title: The brand asks for changes within the allowed rounds
not_disputes.why: The normal review. It turns into a dispute only when the rounds are used up and the brand reports instead of approving.

not_disputes.title: 'It's fine, carry on' on a parcel difference
not_disputes.why: The brand dismissing the difference box; explicitly not a report and it changes nothing else.

not_disputes.title: Pay for Sale brand silence after she posts
not_disputes.why: It confirms itself on the stamped date; nothing is paid at that moment so nobody is harmed.

not_disputes.title: A Remote return that confirms itself
not_disputes.why: The brand did nothing for the Admin number of days; the record says it was automatic. Not a dispute unless the brand reported first.

not_disputes.title: A store-visit time that passed with nothing marked
not_disputes.why: The rules say neither side is blamed and the brand sends a new time.

not_disputes.title: A withdrawal marked 'Could not process'
not_disputes.why: A normal operations answer (wrong bank details): the hold is released and the person asks again.

not_disputes.title: A shopper cancelling before the order ships
not_disputes.why: A normal button with an automatic refund; nobody has to decide anything.

not_disputes.title: Declined, rejected, expired, withdrawn or removed before both signatures
not_disputes.why: Endings before commitment; no money is locked and no one is owed anything.

not_disputes.title: A courier weight-difference or return-to-store charge
not_disputes.why: A cost rule already settled: it is always the brand's, taken from its wallet or recorded as owed; the creator is never involved.

result.area: Where a person can raise a problem today (brand app, creator app, shopper app, brand website) - and where they are stuck with no way out
result.summary: Today a person can raise a problem in six places: four on the brand's phone (change rounds used up, posted wrongly or not posted, parcel difference, return overdue), one on the creator's phone (brand silent after she posted - Pay for Content and Hybrid only) and the shopper's Return / Replace. Only the shopper's request reaches INFLX (every admin is notified and decides in Admin > Returns); the five collaboration reports notify no admin and appear on no admin screen, and a brand's content report freezes the collaboration with no way back except INFLX moving the money by hand in Admin > Money > Disputes and corrections. Most waiting states have no exit, and three are hard stops found in the code: a store visit cannot be given a new time once the posting date has passed, a parcel lost by the courier has no report in either direction, and a shipped order cannot be cancelled by anyone - shopper, brand or INFLX. No app has a help or contact button on a work screen; each has only a Legal list that shows INFLX's email and phone number as plain text, and the website's complaint form only composes an email. Four things on live screens need attention whatever is decided: brands read "Item 18 picks it up" after a parcel report; the rules still say a store visit confirms itself after 3 days while the app (founder, 1 Oct) says only the brand confirms; her Pay for Content card says the brand reported "what you posted" even when she has not posted; and the brand website tells brands they collect cash-on-delivery money while INFLX's wallet records treat that cash as held by INFLX.

situations.title: The brand has used every round of changes and still will not approve her content
situations.stage: Content review (Pay for Content) or review of the social media version (Pay for Sale, Hybrid), after the last allowed change request
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content, Pay for Sale, Hybrid; Store Visit and Remote
situations.rules_say: Once the stamped rounds are used the brand may only approve or report to INFLX; a third round is never given. The report records a dispute, freezes the step and leaves her fee locked.
situations.today_entry_point: Pay for Content: button 'Report to INFLX' on the brand's content screen, shown only once the rounds are used (BrandContentScreen.js:244), opening 'Report this to INFLX?'. Pay for Sale / Hybrid: 'Something's wrong — tell INFLX' opens 'What's wrong?' with the one reason 'Rounds used...' and the button 'Tell INFLX' (BrandSaleLiveScreen.js:117-121, 289-297). Both call POST /campaigns/:id/sets/:sid/invitations/:ciId/content/report with kind rounds_used (item12.routes.js:43).
situations.today_effect: An optional note of up to 500 characters; no photo or file. The report is stamped once, every later action is refused with 'INFLX is looking at this', reminders stop, and both sides are notified (the same sentence on Pay for Content; each side its own on Pay for Sale and Hybrid). The brand then sees 'Reported to INFLX ... stays in escrow until it is settled'; on Pay for Content she sees 'They told INFLX — {brand} reported a problem with what you posted' although she has not posted anything yet. It cannot be taken back, no admin is told, and no admin screen shows the report or the note.
situations.money_at_stake: Pay for Content and Hybrid: the first 25% is already in her wallet; the other 75% stays locked with INFLX. Pay for Sale: no fixed money; her shop posts keep selling.
situations.gap: Nobody at INFLX learns of it; the note is saved and read by no screen; she cannot answer; nothing can lift the freeze; and her Pay for Content card describes the wrong problem.
possible_outcomes: INFLX finds the content meets the agreement: it counts as approved, she posts, payments run as normal
INFLX allows one extra round by hand, then normal flow
INFLX finds it does not meet the agreement: locked 75% goes back to the brand, she keeps the first 25%, collaboration ends as Disputed
Split: second 25% released to her, final 50% returned to the brand
Both settle outside INFLX; INFLX records the result and closes
open_questions: What does INFLX judge against - only the agreed deliverable list, or quality too?
May INFLX approve on the brand's behalf or grant an extra round?
Does she keep the first 25% in every outcome?
How quickly must INFLX answer?
situations.check: corrected: both sides get the same words only on Pay for Content (Pay for Sale and Hybrid send each side its own sentence); added that her Pay for Content card says the problem is with 'what you posted' when she has not posted

situations.title: The brand says what she posted is wrong, incomplete, or was never posted
situations.stage: After she taps 'I've posted everything' and before the brand confirms it is live (Pay for Sale / Hybrid: also after approval once the posting date has passed)
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content, Pay for Sale, Hybrid; both modes
situations.rules_say: The brand does not confirm; it reports instead, which is a dispute with no third answer. The step freezes, a Pay for Sale self-confirmation stops, the money stays locked, and her shop posts stay in the shop.
situations.today_entry_point: Text button 'Something's wrong — tell INFLX' under the confirm button (BrandContentScreen.js:250; BrandSaleLiveScreen.js:289-290). Pay for Content sends one reason (posted wrong); Pay for Sale / Hybrid offers 'She hasn't posted it', 'It isn't what I approved', 'Something is missing' (copy14.js:161-165). Same API as the rounds report.
situations.today_effect: Optional note, no attachment - the brand cannot add a screenshot of what is actually live. Same freeze as the rounds report; on Pay for Sale it also stops the 7-day self-confirmation. A 'She hasn't posted it' report made after approval also shuts her out of adding links or marking it posted. On Pay for Content there is no 'she never posted' report: after approval the brand's screen only says 'You approved it. {name} is posting it now.'
situations.money_at_stake: Pay for Content and Hybrid: second 25% and final 50% (75% of the fee) locked with INFLX. Pay for Sale: none.
situations.gap: No proof upload, no admin view, no way to lift the freeze if she corrects or completes the post, and Pay for Content has no report for 'approved but never posted'.
possible_outcomes: She corrects or re-posts: INFLX lifts the freeze, the brand confirms, payments run as normal
INFLX confirms it live in the brand's place: second 25% released, final 50% on its date
INFLX returns the locked 75% to the brand; she keeps the first 25%; collaboration ends as Disputed
Split: second 25% to her, final 50% back to the brand
Pay for Sale: marked complete or ended with no money moving; her posts keep selling either way
open_questions: If she fixes the post, who un-freezes and who confirms - the brand again, or INFLX?
On Pay for Sale no money is held: what does 'settled' mean there - only a mark on her record?
Should Pay for Content get the 'she hasn't posted' reason that Pay for Sale already has?
situations.check: corrected: added that a 'she hasn't posted it' report made after approval also stops her from posting or adding links; the rest confirmed

situations.title: She has posted, and the brand does not confirm it is live
situations.stage: After she marks it posted, from the seventh day of brand silence
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content and Hybrid only (Pay for Sale confirms itself after 7 days and has no such button)
situations.rules_say: No automatic confirmation where confirming pays money. After the Admin number of days (7) she may tell INFLX; it records a dispute, moves no money and freezes nothing - the brand may still confirm and pay.
situations.today_entry_point: Button 'Ask INFLX to look at it' (Pay for Content, ContentScreen.js:406-407) or 'Ask INFLX to look' (Hybrid, SaleLiveScreen.js:604-605). Before the date her screen says from which day she may ask. Calls POST /influencers/me/invitations/:ciId/content/report with kind brand_silent (item12.routes.js:30).
situations.today_effect: Optional note, no attachment. Her request is stamped; nothing freezes; the brand gets a notice and a banner 'She asked INFLX to look ... You can still confirm it'; she sees 'You asked INFLX to look at this on {date}' and the button disappears. Once only, cannot be taken back. No admin is told; Admin > Money > Collaboration money > 'Waiting on a brand' shows how many days ago she posted, but not that she asked.
situations.money_at_stake: Second 25% and final 50% of her fee (75%) locked with INFLX; the first 25% is already hers.
situations.gap: Her request reaches nobody. The admin tool to pay her in the brand's place exists, but nothing connects her request to it and there is no deadline for INFLX to act.
possible_outcomes: The brand confirms after the nudge: normal payments
INFLX stands in for the brand: second 25% released now, final 50% paid on its date (tool already built)
The brand answers with a 'posted wrongly' report: becomes the situation above
open_questions: After how many more days does INFLX stand in - automatically, or always a person's decision?
Must INFLX open the links and check before standing in?
Does the brand get a final warning with a date?

situations.title: Something in the parcel she received was missing, damaged or different
situations.stage: Remote shoot - after delivery, when she checks each item
situations.raised_by: creator records it; brand may escalate
situations.against: unclear by nature - the brand's packing, the courier, or her own claim
situations.applies_to: Remote only; all three aims
situations.rules_say: A difference never stops her. It is recorded, the brand is told and Admin can see it; the brand may report it to INFLX, which becomes a dispute. A Return item she marked missing is not expected back.
situations.today_entry_point: Creator: 'Missing' / 'Damaged' against each item on her parcel screen, with a note of up to 300 characters (RemoteShootScreen.js:169-198; POST .../remote/check, item11.routes.js:51). Brand: 'Report to INFLX' or 'It's fine, carry on' (BrandRemoteScreen.js:240-246; POST .../remote/report kind difference, item11.routes.js:37-38).
situations.today_effect: The brand's pop-up 'Report this to INFLX?' has no note box and sends only the reason. It stamps a date and writes a diary line - nothing else: the creator is not told, no admin is told, nothing is held. The brand then reads 'Reported to INFLX on {date}. Item 18 picks it up.' - internal wording on a live screen. Once only, no undo.
situations.money_at_stake: The brand's own products and the courier charge already taken from its wallet; the money locked for the return pickup (released back to the brand if every Return item is marked missing). The collaboration fee is not touched.
situations.gap: Admin cannot see it anywhere although the rules say Admin can; no photo from either side; her word alone removes a 'missing' Return item from what she must send back.
possible_outcomes: Recorded only; the shoot carries on (today's result)
INFLX raises a courier claim and credits the brand's wallet if it is paid
INFLX corrects the brand's balance by hand for a courier fault
Her claim is judged false: noted on her record; the item is treated as received and expected back
open_questions: Is the value of a lost or damaged product ever recovered inside INFLX, or always outside it?
Will INFLX raise courier claims on the brand's behalf?
Should she add a photo when she marks an item missing or damaged?

situations.title: The lent products do not come back, or come back missing or damaged
situations.stage: Remote shoot - the return, after she marks the shoot done
situations.applies_to: Remote with Return items; all three aims
situations.rules_say: Past the due date both see the return as overdue, she is reminded and the brand may report it; nothing moves on its own. A returned item that is missing or damaged may be reported, which stops the self-confirmation. The return never holds up content or any payment, and nothing is ever charged to her.
situations.today_entry_point: Overdue: text button 'Report it to INFLX' (BrandRemoteScreen.js:247-249). Came back missing or damaged: none on the phone - the server accepts that report and the words 'Something's missing or damaged' exist (copy11.js:119; remoteShoot.service.js:335) but no screen shows the button.
situations.today_effect: Overdue report: a date stamp and a diary line, no note, nobody told, nothing held. 'Overdue' only exists when she has marked the shoot done and has booked no pickup - a pickup she booked that the courier never collects is never overdue and has no report. For a bad return the brand can tick Missing or Damaged on 'What came back?', but the return is confirmed anyway and she is told 'confirmed the items you sent back. That's everything on the products side.'
situations.money_at_stake: The brand's products, and the return-pickup money locked from its wallet. She may still be owed up to 75% of her fee, which the rules say the return can never touch.
situations.gap: No working button for a damaged or missing return; no report at all when a pickup is booked but nothing is handed over; reports reach nobody; and since nothing may be charged to her or held, INFLX has no lever today.
possible_outcomes: INFLX contacts her and the pickup is booked
The brand lets her keep it (Return becomes Gift) and accepts the loss
Her remaining payment is held until the items are back (the rules forbid this today)
The product's value is taken from her remaining fee (the rules forbid this today)
Recorded; settled outside INFLX; her account paused for new collaborations until it is settled
open_questions: May an unreturned or damaged product ever hold or reduce her fee? The rules currently say never.
Who decides the value of a product?
Does serious non-return pause or close her account?
situations.check: corrected: added that 'overdue' needs the shoot marked done and no pickup booked, so a booked pickup that never happens has no report at all

situations.title: A shopper says a delivered item is wrong, damaged, does not fit - or disagrees with INFLX's answer
situations.stage: Shopper order - after delivery, inside the return window, and after INFLX has answered
situations.applies_to: Every order placed from a shoppable post (Pay for Sale and Hybrid collaborations)
situations.rules_say: INFLX decides every request; the brand sees it and is told but does not decide. While a request is open the sale's three shares wait. A rejection changes nothing and is one answer per item.
situations.today_entry_point: 'Return', 'Return deal' or 'Return or replace' on Order details, shown only after delivery and inside the window (OrderScreens.js:355-365), then 'Request return' / 'Request replacement'. Calls POST /follower/orders/lines/:id/return or /replace (follower.routes.js:101-106).
situations.today_effect: Five reasons; a written note only for 'Other' on a return, and required for 'damaged' or 'not as shown' on one item of a deal; no photo. She sees 'INFLX is looking at your return'; the brand is notified and sees it view-only; every admin is notified and decides in Admin > Returns (a rejection needs a note she is shown). A rejected return is final for that item and she cannot withdraw a request.
situations.money_at_stake: Her payment sits with INFLX (online orders). The creator's commission, the brand's share and INFLX's share all wait while a request is open and are reversed if it is refunded.
situations.gap: No photo proof although the in-app refund policy tells her to add photos; no way to question a rejection although the same policy tells her to 'reply to us on the same request'; no way to withdraw a request.
possible_outcomes: Approved: the store collects the item, full refund, all three shares reversed
Replacement brought by the store at its own cost; no money moves
One item's share refunded; she keeps the rest of the deal
Rejected with a note: the sale stands and the shares are paid when the window closes
Goodwill refund paid by INFLX from its own share without the item coming back
open_questions: May a shopper appeal a rejected return once, with new proof?
Are photos required for 'damaged' and 'not as shown'?
Should the policy text be corrected, or the promised photos and reply thread built?
situations.check: corrected: stated exactly when a note is asked for; moved 'refund not received' to its own situation; added that the refund policy promises a reply thread that does not exist

situations.title: A shipped order never reaches the shopper - lost, refused at the door, or marked Delivered when she did not get it
situations.stage: Shopper order - from the moment the brand marks it Shipped
situations.raised_by: shopper (or the brand, when the parcel comes back to it)
situations.applies_to: Every order placed from a shoppable post
situations.rules_say: The brand ships and marks Packed, Shipped, Out for delivery and Delivered itself; after Shipped, cancelling is closed. Until a courier connection exists the Delivered status is the delivery confirmation. My orders is meant to offer 'Track · Cancel · Need help'.
situations.today_entry_point: none - after it ships her Order details shows only 'It has shipped. You can return it once delivered.' (OrderScreens.js:351-368; copyOrder.js:207), and the code notes 'Need help' is still waiting for a support contact (OrderScreens.js:369). The brand's website offers only 'Mark Out for Delivery' and 'Mark Delivered' after Shipped (dashboard/fulfillment/page.js:281, 376-384).
situations.today_effect: Nothing is recorded. A shipped order cannot be cancelled by anyone: the shopper and the brand are refused (shopperOrders.service.js:38, 413, 440), and Admin > Orders can only move a status forward - its 'Cancel' button is refused by the server (shopperOrders.service.js:605-609; admin/orders/page.js:76-84). The brand's own 'Mark Delivered' tap starts the return window, and when it closes the three shares go to the wallets.
situations.money_at_stake: Online order: her payment held by INFLX. Cash order: nothing has been paid yet. The creator's commission, the brand's share and INFLX's share are released on the strength of the brand's own 'Delivered' tap.
situations.gap: No 'I didn't get it' or 'Need help' button, no proof of delivery, no way for the brand to say the parcel came back undelivered, and no way for INFLX to cancel and refund a shipped order - today the only route to a refund is to mark it Delivered and then run a return.
possible_outcomes: The brand shows courier proof: the order stands
INFLX cancels the item and refunds her in full; all three shares reversed (needs a new admin action)
The brand sends it again
Shares already paid out: INFLX takes them back from the wallets by balance correction
open_questions: Until Shiprocket carries shopper orders, what counts as proof of delivery?
How many days after Shipped may a shopper ask for her money back?
Should the sale's shares wait while a 'not received' claim is open?
Should the brand get a 'came back undelivered' button, and INFLX a cancel-after-shipping tool?
situations.check: corrected: Admin cannot cancel a shipped order either (status moves forward only and the admin Cancel button is refused); added the brand's side (parcel refused or returned); on a cash order no money has reached INFLX

situations.title: She sent her content and the brand never reviews it
situations.stage: Content review - the package is with the brand, neither approved nor sent back
situations.applies_to: Pay for Content, Pay for Sale, Hybrid; both modes
situations.rules_say: There is no time limit on either side; whoever must move is reminded. If the brand stops after the agreement it is a dispute INFLX handles - but no route is described for her at this step.
situations.today_entry_point: none - her screen only says '{brand} are reviewing this. You can change it if they ask for changes.' (ContentScreen.js:318-320) or 'With {brand} since {date}. You'll hear when they reply.' (SaleLiveScreen.js:473-485). The server refuses a creator's report unless she has already posted (contentFlow.service.js:787).
situations.today_effect: The brand is reminded every 48 hours and it sits in the brand's list of things to do. Nothing is recorded as a problem. Admin's 'Waiting on a brand' tab does list the collaboration, but only as 'Second 25% · waits for the brand to confirm it's live' - no stage and no count of days.
situations.money_at_stake: Pay for Content and Hybrid: 75% of her fee locked, and neither payment can start because she is not allowed to post. Pay for Sale: no money, but the collaboration cannot complete.
situations.gap: No button, no silence clock at this step, and nothing in Admin that says the brand has sat on a review. It is the same harm as silence after posting, one step earlier, with no remedy.
possible_outcomes: INFLX nudges and the brand reviews
After a set number of days the content counts as approved and she may post
INFLX approves in the brand's place
